queries.query: LocalLens roadmap covers local semantic search, indexing, and evidence retrieval.
Privacy notes explain selected-folder indexing, excluded secrets, and relative paths.
Sync notes describe added, updated, deleted, skipped, and excluded file counts.
LocalLens stores searchable units with named text and vision vectors plus a manifest for stale result filtering.
The desktop interface includes folder selection, indexing actions, query input, modality filters, and result rows with snippets.
Server mode comparison records indexing time, search latency, integrity counts, and storage behavior separately from local mode.
LocalLens는 선택한 폴더만 인덱싱하고 민감 파일과 절대 경로 노출을 차단한다.
LocalLens 동기화는 manifest를 기준으로 추가, 변경, 삭제, 제외 상태를 검증한다.
LocalLens는 텍스트, PDF 페이지, 이미지 단위를 분리해 멀티모달 검색 근거로 저장한다.
Embedding profiles record text and vision model names, vector dimensions, and reindex boundaries.
Release gate checks tests, benchmarks, artifact scans, blocked expressions, and measured evidence.
Desktop error handling restores progress indicators and action buttons before showing an error message.
